summary: Reviewed src/engine/hand.ts and src/engine/invariants.ts against base dffb820. Trust boundary unchanged: applyAction still checks hand-complete, then out-of-turn, then requires an exact type+amount match against legalActions before any state change, so the new short all-in amounts can only come from the engine. Chip conservation: a raise to `to = min(fullBetLevel + unit, streetContribution + stack)` gives added = to - streetContribution <= stack. A postflop bet (currentBet 0, streetContribution 0) adds min(unit, stack) <= stack. A call adds min(owe, stack). Stacks cannot go negative and allIn is set exactly when the stack reaches 0. Aggression needs maxTo > currentBet, and fullBetLevel + unit > currentBet always holds, because an uncounted short all-in adds less than unit/2 over the level. So every raise strictly increases currentBet. Safe integers: createHand already enforces safe-integer stacks, with the table total <= MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. All amounts are min() or differences of those values, and 2*(amount - level) is an exact doubling, so the half-bet comparison has no precision loss. The hasActed/betCount changes only narrow what a seat may do (call/fold after an uncounted all-in), so the cap stays bounded. The invariant checker derives the counted level independently. Existing tests (illegal-actions: 100k random injected illegal actions rejected byte-identical; chip-safety) plus the new short-all-in suites pass locally. No new dependencies, randomness changes, I/O, secrets or injection surfaces. No findings.
